description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Croatia Croatia 2026 article 1 general holiday facts with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when croatia 2026 article 1 general holidays over an explicitly selected Monday-Friday planning baseline. Article 2 memorial days do not add rest. Article 3 religious rights depend on the person and, for specified festivals, the chosen day; they are not included in a universal union. Individual shifts, replacement weekly rest, employer/local/sector/school/bank schedules, payroll, legal deadlines and future years are not computed.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events. Requires explicit mon_fri_planning; memorials and person-specific religious rights are not general rest.
Example user requests: Croatia: Good Friday is not a general statutory holiday. | Croatia: Corpus Christi. | Croatia: Independence memorial is not a rest holiday.
Inputs: date (date); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-04-03","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"date":"2026-06-04","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"date":"2026-06-25","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_statutory_holiday, is_commemorative_day, religious_rest_scope, payroll_scope.
Formula: planning_workday = weekday AND no article_1_statutory_holiday
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/croatia-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/croatia-public-working-day.md

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline; not an individual statutory roster.

name: check_hr_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Croatia 2026 article 1 general holiday facts with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline

day_type.description: statutory_holiday, weekend_baseline or regular_workday; memorials alone do not add rest.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_commemorative_day.description: Whether result.date has an article 2 memorial; this does not add rest.

is_statutory_holiday.description: Whether result.date is an article 1 general statutory holiday.

is_working_day.description: Working date in explicit mon_fri_planning article 1 general scope, not individual attendance or religious leave.

religious_rest_scope.description: article_3_person_specific_not_computed: no union or inferred personal religious identity.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Croatia Working Day
